prompt: Phase {k} of 8: {event}. Tap “Correct” if it is right.
adjust_hint: If it is wrong, find the right frame with ◀ ▶ and tap “Set to this frame”.
intro.title: What is this for?
intro.body: Swing phases (address, top, impact…) are detected by rules. Confirm or correct your own swings; with 20 or more you can train a detector on your swing.
intro.privacy: Labels stay on this phone. The exported file has poses and phases only, no video.
empty.done: Every swing with a video is labelled
empty.body: Only swings with a saved video can be labelled. Practise some more and come back.
export.title: Training set
export.hint: Save the labels and pose data as one file for training the detector.
